task: Pre-T009 fixes of the delta security review (evidence/probe-catalog-delta-review.md)
disposition: Engineering at unit level. Nothing native ran: no dedicated account, no sandbox-exec, no claude, no live probe session. No qualification record is written or authorized.

catalogSha256.note: The catalog document carries runnerSha256, so any edit of the probes module moves it.

referenceEnvironmentSha256.note: Illustrative, computed with one fixed synthetic policy for both trees (account braid-lab; run_root /ref/run; config_dir /ref/config; claude /ref/bin/claude; interpreter /ref/lib/python/bin/python under /ref/lib/python; pinned hashes 1,2,3 repeated; proxy port 45000; uid 501; macOS 27.0.1/26A434/arm64; account gids (20,) home mode 0700; supervisor path /ref/bin/supervisor and hash stubbed). It shows that the environment hash moved; a real machine's hash must be recomputed by the issuer. Every earlier t005/t006/t007 input hash and any recorded qualification is stale.

DRV-12.where: quickstart.md operator preparation, ADR 0035 residual risks and implementation state, harness_host_claude.py comment

DRV-16.where: config_dir_listing and config_dir_changes; native_session_driver read_config; row independent.configDir (counts, changed names, digests of added and modified entries; never contents); a cut listing gives counts only; FIFOs are not opened

residuals: The default real_home is the runner's own home; the quickstart says to run only as the dedicated account because the arena plants decoys there.
The config_dir disk measure has no baseline: a config_dir that grew in earlier sessions counts in full and refuses later runs (fail closed).
config_dir_listing hashes at most 500 entries and records unreadable or special files as such; a missing config_dir is unavailable (None), not empty.
MacOSContainment.egress_counters stays as a public read-only accessor with no caller.
